name: Bembel apple wine jug
about: This is a stoneware jug with a blue pattern, traditionally used to serve apple wine in Hesse, the region around Frankfurt.
tip: Buy it at the Römer tourist office.

name: Frankfurt Bethmännchen cookies
about: These are local almond and marzipan cookies, a sweet treat that is closely linked to Frankfurt.
tip: Check whether they are sold in the current season before you go.
